payload.summary: The items list endpoint applies its result limit before the search filter, so searching with pagination silently drops matching results and returns a normal 200 response with an incomplete list instead of an error. No mitigation has been applied to production — there was no live deployment target to mitigate against, so the bug is running unmitigated right now, exactly as it was before anyone looked at it. A fix has been written and verified against the code, but it has not been deployed.
payload.impact: Three reports have come in, and all three are user reports — there is no monitoring or alerting signal independently confirming how far this reaches. Reports began arriving at 9:05 in the morning. Beyond those three reports, there's no data here on how many other people are hitting the same broken results without reporting it.

mitigation.reason: args.live is absent or incomplete: this run had no deploy target to mitigate, so the page must be answered on an unmitigated sev1

timeline.event: Triage classified the issue as a critical, likely-reproducible bug: the search-before-limit ordering truncates results without any error.
No mitigation was applied, because there was no live deployment target to mitigate against.
A fix for the endpoint was drafted and verified.
Three user reports of the problem had come in.
